the relations between brain pathology and temporal lobe epilepsy.

neuronal loss and/or mossy fiber sproutings may be a consequence, not a cause, of chronic seizure activity.

neuronal loss–mussky fiber sprouting is a consequence rather than the cause of temporal lobe epilepsies, which are initiated and maintained by the abnormal excitatory activity of the hippocampus.
